frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.excerpt: Building a front-end application can be a daunting task, especially when you have to deal with a myriad of dependencies, libraries, and build tools. One of the most popular build tools for front-end development is NPM, which provides a reliable and efficient way to manage your project's dependencies, as well as automate build tasks.
frontmatter.subheading: A reliable and efficient way to manage your project's dependencies
frontmatter.title: Front-end Build: NPM Scripts Based Architecture
